headline: RT by @sentdefender: Iraq Crackdowns: Short Assessment ICOD: 11:06, 06/28/2026 BLUF: According to Iraqi and regional media outlets, last night’s wave of arrests and crackdowns came after the arrest and confession of Oil Ministry undersecretary Adnan al-Jumaili. According to regional analysts and subject matter experts, such anti-corruption efforts are common when new leadership takes hold in Iraq. Key Judgement: At the time of writing, there is a reasonable possibility that the aforementioned dynamics are directly related to the arrests, as Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has long signaled his intention to implement institutional reforms whilst simultaneously being pressured by the U.S. to deal with Iranian-backed paramilitary groups in the country. This story will be updated as it develops.
